notes.title: Big Trouble In Little Chimney is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
I'm really excited to announce that the [b]Big Trouble In Little Chimney[/b] is OUT NOW!

Grab your Shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! 🎄

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072710/Big_Trouble_in_Little_Chimney/

Even though the game is finished, I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them.

Thank you to everyone who supported me and my game during the development. Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome!

And special thanks to my lovely wife Silvia for her GREAT patience :)

Have fun, folks!

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - February 1, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/87b0b3f06a00a0f6e42c06720dd0a9436ac2d0da.png[/img]
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added: "Missions Completed:" to the Stats Screen[/b]

[b]Added: New Achievement[/b]
Completionist - (complete 100 missions)

[b]Changed: "Devils Finger" Achievement[/b]
from Destroy 100K Numbers to Destroy 50K

[b]Changed: "Gods Hand" Achievement[/b]
from Destroy 1M Numbers to Destroy 100K

[b]Changed: Quit Screen[/b]


Enjoy the game and have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 21, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/3ab9d0394416815e80927ecf76913da48dcb2fbc.png[/img]
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added: Ability to sell items in the shop.[/b]
Now, you can sell all the items from your inventory.
(sell price is in the parenthesis)

[b]Added: Randomization for lock-picking.[/b]
Each time you'll try to open a chest, the lock will be in the random position.


Happy Gaming! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 9, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/4070c81a07914498f8dadcc3ffefd612697d0d90.png[/img]
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added:[/b] New Lock picking system
Try to open the lock with a new puzzle mini-game!

[b]Fixed:[/b] Bug with the apples bought in the store
(mission - eat 3 apples)

[b]Fixed:[/b] Bug with tokens
(mission - open 3 treasure chests)

[b]Fixed:[/b] Bug with Hi-Score (after win the game)

[b]Changed:[/b] Lowered the price for armor repair in the shop.

[b]Changed:[/b] The position for the combo bar


Happy gaming! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 3, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/8635c71f44fd4c3ad39bc4c549104e862bff3948.png[/img]

[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added: Save Game feature[/b]
Shrine and Bonfire will save your game progress automatically.
If you quit the game you can easily continue from this place.
[i]Don't forget: If you'll die, you'll die = permadeath.[/i]

[b]Changed: The power of spell for Sorcerer[/b]
without power-up (old: 3-4 new: 2-3)
with power-up (old: 5-6 new: 4-5)


Happy gaming! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 28, 2018
notes.notes:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Fixed: "Assassin bug" (coin bug)[/b]
Sometimes, if you played with Assassin, player could not continue after kill the enemy.

[b]Added: 5 New Achievements[/b]
Knight, Sorcerer, Assassin, Grandalf, Shopaholic


[b]Special thanks to:[/b] [b]aquaronin[/b] and [b]NoobiK[/b]
for the bug report about "Silent Assassin bug"


Enjoy the game and have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 27, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/975d142bdceb77b32505ad513f0d96f47a351c7b.png[/img]

[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added: Start-Up Machine[/b]
This awesome machine will help you with the progress of your hard journey. If you have a token, you can use it at the start of the each game. Tokens can be obtained by completing missions.

Try your luck and win one of the useful prizes! :titomosquito:

[b]Added: 2 New Achievements[/b]
Dark Soulz and Gambler

Enjoy the game! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 19, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34030378/99c447f532c39bfc9a902f0ec959c73289c6966c.png[/img]

[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added: Cyclopedia (encyclopedia)[/b]
You can find here info about Monsters, Items and Power-Ups.
Monsters and Power-Ups will unlock as you progress through the game.

Enjoy the game! :)
